met_analysis:
The Low Pressure Area over Northwest Bay of Bengal off north Odisha -West Bengal coasts now lies over Northwest Bay of Bengal and adjoining North Odisha -West Bengal coasts at 0830 hrs IST of today, 15th July, 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 7.6 km above mean sea level tilting southwestwards with height. It is very likely become Well Marked Low Pressure Area and move northwestwards across North Odisha & Gangetic West Bengal during next 2 days.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Jammu, Dehradun, Shahjahanpur, Basti, Patna, Bankura, centre of Low Pressure area over Northwest Bay of Bengal and adjoining north Odisha -West Bengal coasts and thence southeastwards towards east-central Bay of Bengal.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over North Pakistan & adjoining Jammu persists and now seen between 3.1 & 5.8 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Northwest Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over East Uttar Pradesh & adjoining Biharat 0.9 km above mean sea level.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over East Assam & neighbourhood at 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over north Gujarat & adjoining southwest Rajasthan persists and now seen between 3.1 & 5.8 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulationover East Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood at 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
A fresh Western Disturbance is likely to affect Northwest India from 19th July.
